name: vstest.console.exe
description: VSTest.Console.exe is the command-line tool to run tests
author: Onat Uzunyayla

commands.description: VSTest functionality may allow an adversary to executes their malware by wrapping it as a test method then build it to a .exe or .dll file to be later run by vstest.console.exe. This may both allow AWL bypass or defense bypass in general
commands.usecase: Proxy Execution and AWL bypass, Adversaries may run malicious code embedded inside the test methods of crafted dll/exe
